items.title: EgoCARBS: Egocentric Video Meets Active Acoustics for Kitchen Action Understanding
items.summary: Egocentric video records what a person looks at, but often misses what their body does: the hands leave the frame, and arm motion goes unseen. An exocentric camera recovers this context, but it must be installed wherever the activity happens.
